guard: The journal refuses what it cannot faithfully hold: an oversized ok result ahead of the settling append (L5006), and a seeded entry whose state or status is outside the vocabulary, which lookup would otherwise misread as a replayable success. (FAIL-FAST suite: markers are upstream of the cells they guard.)

mutations.name: the result bound is measured and never enforced
mutations.find: if (bytes > this.resultBytes) throw new EffectResultTooLarge(k, bytes, this.resultBytes);
mutations.expectRed: an oversized ok result is refused with L5006
mutations.completionMarker: ok a settled entry with NO status is refused at the seed
mutations.cell: an oversized ok result is refused with L5006
mutations.note: The oversized result then settles and persists, so the first L5006 cell reds; the seed-guard cells upstream are untouched by this line and keep the marker green.

mutations.name: the status vocabulary guard is disabled at the seed
mutations.expectRed: a settled entry with an unknown status is refused at the seed
mutations.completionMarker: ok recorded history without pins is refused (L5021)
mutations.cell: a settled entry with an unknown status is refused at the seed
mutations.note: With the guard gone the corrupted entry falls through every lookup verdict into replay and the resume completes silently, which is the measured pre-guard behavior this cell exists to keep dead.

mutations.name: the state vocabulary guard is disabled at the seed
mutations.expectRed: an entry with an unknown state is refused at the seed
mutations.completionMarker: ok a settled entry with an unknown status is refused at the seed
mutations.cell: an entry with an unknown state is refused at the seed
mutations.note: A state outside the vocabulary with a valid status slips past the status guard (its condition requires state settled), so only its own guard can catch it, and only this cell can see that guard go.
